name: agentic-jwt
description: Use the Rust Agentic JWT file service with independent signed approvals and durable execution records.

interface.longDescription: Set up native Rust workspace tools with a local human review page. Supports nested files, creation, and signed approvals. Existing Linux, WSL, and SSH service connections remain supported.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Agentic JWT to inspect a file and propose a change for independent human review.
